expected_doubts.title: Vardhman's 2.5% discount applies only if a single PO exceeds Rs 25 lakh
expected_doubts.why: Footnote on page 3. The RFQ says monthly POs per vendor run Rs 15-30 lakh, so whether it applies depends on how the award is split and how POs are raised.

expected_doubts.title: Rohit Box: freight extra, amount not given
expected_doubts.why: Rohit wins lines in the cheapest-overall view only before freight. Last year's freight was Rs 0.30/box.

expected_doubts.title: Anand offered 3-ply on L14 where 5-ply was asked
expected_doubts.why: If accepted, Anand wins L14 at a much lower price.

expected_doubts.title: Kaveri L09 at Rs 5.79/box is far below should-cost
expected_doubts.why: Looks like a typo in the per-100 rate. If real, Kaveri wins L09 in the quality scenario.

expected_doubts.title: Anand L19 handwritten correction: 31.20 or 37.20?
expected_doubts.expected_behaviour: Should be logged, not escalated: neither reading changes who wins L19.

expected_logged_not_escalated: Shree Balaji ex-works plus Rs 0.35 freight from the T&C sheet
Shree Balaji revised offer R1 supersedes 0418 for L05, L11, L24

Rohit Box 7-ply rate and printing resolved from last year's quote
L21 is 73% above last year's price because it changed from 5-ply to 7-ply (explained, not an anomaly)
Anand did not quote L07, L22, L30
